description: Hasebroekstraat 90-114 (1915): four-storey brown-brick fronts of a single and a paired window axis, white small-paned sashes, three green glazed tiles under the single window on every upper storey, a shallow cornice under a red-tile roof face; over the pair a pointed gable with an attic light or a dormer; the house doors in pairs (green double doors at every other party wall, mirrored neighbours)

match.note: shares year and width with the tile-bay rows (Hasebroekstraat 56-70); the tile-bay type needs its one-sided white bay stack, this one does not, and the challengers settle the rest; 2026-10-16 (2): the white bay test is the exposure-normalised bay width (blockFace/stripStructure.ts, plain window columns <= 1.3 m), not the accent share; balcony fronts (Jan Hanzenstraat 49-51, Ten Katestraat 29, Bellamystraat 18-20) veto it; a gable over the pair reads 2.4-2.7 m wide with its shoulder taken for the eaves (Hasebroekstraat 69, Van Effenstraat 9 and 10: 2.15-2.67 m wide, rise 1.6-1.8 m), hence the point-gable alternative; 2026-10-16 (2): 1911-1918 only (yearSlack 1): Bellamystraat 117-119 (1919) are Amsterdam School fronts with a raised brick crown and a stacked balconette axis that the green-tile type drew (review of the 2026-10-16 run); the point gable of Hasebroekstraat 109A rises 1.97 m

dormers.note: Hasebroekstraat 98, 92: a small dormer over the single axis and a larger one over the pair, on the red-tile roof face

point-gable.note: Hasebroekstraat 96, 94, 90: a pointed brick gable over the pair with one attic light

door-left.note: the house doors under a gridded transom in the single axis, at the left party wall

rhythm.bays: a single axis and a pair
rhythm.identicalBays: no: the single window is low and wide
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the door pairs meet at every other party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: green double doors in the single axis, two windows
rhythm.roofline: shallow cornice, red tiles, a pointed gable or dormers over the pair

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 1-5: mirrored pairs, green tiles under the single window, pointed gables over the pairs of 96, 94, 90 and dormers on 98, 92
strip.jpg 2018-06-13: the same fronts (dark, scaffolding on 114)

schemaLimits: one window kind per storey: the single axis's low wide multi-pane window is drawn as a small-over-one sash like the pair
the double house doors are drawn as one door
notes: Kit added: tilePanels place "sills" (square tiles under a window) beside the tile-bay type's "piers" diamonds.
